pr_title: Preserve authored trigger layout identity in native disclosure conversion
summary: When a captured menu trigger is converted to native details/summary, its former parent layout child was replaced by a wrapper that did not retain the source ID, classes, or inline layout style. The wrapper now owns those layout attributes while summary remains the only interactive control. This restores authored direct-child placement for ID/class/style selectors without measured coordinates or source-specific selectors. Fresh VitAmore before/after browser evidence was not captured in this attempt, so no live-site correction is claimed.
what_changed: wireCapturedDialogs moves the trigger ID and inline style to the details wrapper and retains its classes on both details and summary; IDs are not duplicated, and semantic/event attributes are not copied to the wrapper.

Added Chromium regression coverage for button and div[role=button] triggers in a direct-child grid at 390, 768, and 1440 CSS pixels, including exact trigger/header/content/document geometry and repeated resize cycles.
The regression exercises Enter activation, Escape closure, and focus restoration on summary. Existing responsive visibility behavior remains covered by the interaction-capture tests.

The regression's source relation is a neutral authored fixture; its change kind is layout-identity preservation in the export wiring; verification capability is deterministic local Chromium comparison. It does not establish behavior for CSS selectors qualified by the original trigger tag, because those selectors cannot match the replacement details element without stylesheet selector rewriting.

Evidence boundary: no fresh live baseline/candidate liberation or VitAmore phone/tablet/desktop measurement was completed. Requested/effective iPhone viewport, route rectangles, screenshots, and frozen-phone raster status therefore remain unverified here.
compatibility: Narrow export behavior change for captured dialog/menu triggers. Layout IDs and inline styles now move to the wrapper, and classes are available to both wrapper and summary. This can affect CSS that explicitly expects those attributes only on the summary; duplicate IDs and nested interactive controls are avoided. Original-tag-qualified CSS rules remain a known gap and require targeted selector-preservation design before claiming complete preservation of authored styling. No destination or runtime API changes are made.
used_for: Used OpenCode with model gpt-6-luna and AI assistance to inspect source/export and browser test primitives, implement the scoped change, and run bounded verification. Observed commands: npm ci; npm test -- src/lib/static-dialogs.test.ts src/lib/screenshot/interaction-capture.test.ts src/lib/fidelity/dialog-probe.test.ts (42 passed); npm run build (passed after correcting the test measurement); npm run test:package (passed). Generated dist was restored from HEAD. These are attempt observations, not Homeboy's authoritative final gates. The initial environment lacked dependencies; lockfile installation reported five audit vulnerabilities.
